acceptanceCriteria: Fresh exact actual-owner/scope/no-lease/no-HOLD/nonquiesced policy guards precede each source utility and direct source root.
Original and freshly observed upstream Default are immutable commit roles; the reserved repository HEAD is navigation/objectstore only.
Every selected whole logical source file has exact raw git cat-file --batch framing, whole bytes, Git blob SHA-1, SHA-256, type, size, and commit:path binding.
Read applicable root/src instructions, relevant AGENTS inventory, whole target, real claims/roles producer, real test fixture inputs, and bounded relevant history.
Give distinct source decisions for F231 user claims, F232 admin role claims, and F233 local role claims, without deduplication by shared file/card/helper.
Describe concrete cardinality/frequency, equality/type/value/order/duplicate/exception contracts, and source-versus-runtime/materiality limitations.
At most 15 whole logical product/doc/test/config files per immutable role and 32 direct Git/gh source roots including failed attempts.
Preserve failed attempts, raw source-root streams, exact argv, creation-bound roots and observers, actual root waits, both stream closures, observed-child terminal receipts, and observation limits.
Seal byte index, complete whole-role source bindings, assessment, failures and terminal receipts, without claiming final outer tool success before it returns.
excluded: SDK activation, product-native code execution, compilation, tests, restore, runtime/browser/server scenarios, performance measurements, fabricated large fixtures or isolated Contains workloads
Shipping/test/candidate edits, shared/policy/lease/ledger/publication writes, remote execution, subagents, or campaign-status changes
completionMeaning: Source-only qualification and handoff, not a measured result, behavioral pass, false-positive finding, ledger acceptance or publication.
